name: Reynard Soft7 #1 (Art 033)
description: Reynard Soft7 on Robinhood Chain mainnet. SoftReynard7 card from The Seventh Gate. Art slot 033. The Fox card locks FOX (0x387fbf7128868093D5E22A5528A5fC3D2BA8c9f5).
